topic: The CAS suite generator reconciles 296 source
canonical_claim: The CAS suite generator reconciles 296 source Cas suites after excluding CascadeWriteBuffer to 278 runnable suites: 19 compile-guarded suites are excluded and CASBackendContract contributes both CASInMemory/ and CASLocal/ instantiation spellings.

topic: The fold_reduce phase publishes frontier_complete alongside suppress_destructive
canonical_claim: The `fold_reduce` phase publishes `frontier_complete` alongside `suppress_destructive`, allowing tests and operators to read the gate's verdict instead of recomputing `namespaces > 0 && proven == namespaces` from a tally.

topic: When a frontier deficit is nonzero, the
canonical_claim: When a frontier deficit is nonzero, the suppression warning appends `unproven: <bucket>=<count>, ...`; rounds with no deficit omit the clause.

topic: FoldResult::FrontierUnproven records a reason per unproven namespace
canonical_claim: `FoldResult::FrontierUnproven` records a reason per unproven namespace, while `FoldResult::FrontierDeficit` exposes nine counters and `count`/`total`/`describe` helpers; suppression logs append an `unproven:` clause when the deficit is nonzero.

topic: Each fan-out with work increments CasBlobUploadFanoutBatches once
canonical_claim: Each fan-out with work increments `CasBlobUploadFanoutBatches` once, and each unique-reference task dispatched increments `CasBlobUploadFanoutTasks` once.

topic: The namespace-cleanup phase publishes janitor_pages, janitor_keys, and
canonical_claim: The namespace-cleanup phase publishes `janitor_pages`, `janitor_keys`, and `janitor_deleted` metrics.

topic: Observed object-store enumeration holes were short adjacent
canonical_claim: Observed object-store enumeration holes were short adjacent runs of 2–15 keys rather than page-sized gaps of about 1000 keys.

topic: The T6a append-concurrency reproduction ran 935 rounds
canonical_claim: The T6a append-concurrency reproduction ran 935 rounds across 4 streams with zero deficits; a counterfactual old predicate fired 12 times out of 935.

topic: The RefCowMap design's correctness/testing plan requires the
canonical_claim: The `RefCowMap` design's correctness/testing plan requires the existing `Ca*:Cas*` gtest battery to stay green at 905/905 as evidence that behavior is byte-identical.

topic: A 2026-07-19 post-fix live chaos-soak measurement (workers=6
canonical_claim: A 2026-07-19 post-fix live chaos-soak measurement (workers=6, per-operation-unit attribution via ProfileEvents/part_log/content_addressed_garbage_collection_log) found a GC success round costs ~55-100x more per unit than a single INSERT/MERGE/MUTATE — not from PUTs (GC issues almost none) but from GET+HEAD volume in the retire/recheck verification pipeline ($0.00725/round vs $0.000085/INSERT); DownloadPart (replication fetch) was the cheapest unit at ~24x cheaper than an INSERT, confirming it as a lightweight metadata-level operation.

topic: Cross-referencing generic S3-level counters (S3PutObject/S3GetObject/S3HeadObject/S3ListObjects/DiskS3DeleteObjects) against CAS's
canonical_claim: Cross-referencing generic S3-level counters (`S3PutObject`/`S3GetObject`/`S3HeadObject`/`S3ListObjects`/`DiskS3DeleteObjects`) against CAS's own semantic per-object-kind counters (`Cas{Blob,Gc,Manifest,Meta,Root,Other}{Put,Get,Head,Delete,List}`) in one soak session found the Cas-level counters covered PUT/GET/LIST far better than the query_log/part_log/GC-log attribution axis (77-96% vs 4-58%) because they are incremented at the S3-call site independent of ThreadGroup attribution, while HEAD stayed persistently under-attributed on both axes (~56%), left as an open question.

topic: Deep read-path profiling in the campaign found
canonical_claim: Deep read-path profiling in the campaign found `DownloadPart` (relink fetch) is the dominant read cost: 28.7k fetches cost 1.02M GET + 1.96M HEAD requests despite zero blob re-upload, driven by per-file `loadMeta` GET plus occupancy/adopt HEAD; the identified optimization lever is manifest-trust adoption without per-file probes.

topic: At soak checkpoints, both replicas must match
canonical_claim: At soak checkpoints, both replicas must match an independent SQL model, ca-fsck must report dangling=0, and ca-gc-dryrun must propose only genuinely unreachable objects.

topic: A CAS health check should inspect correctness
canonical_claim: A CAS health check should inspect correctness invariants and broad audit-log reasons before evaluating performance metrics.

topic: system.blob_storage_log does not log reads by default
canonical_claim: `system.blob_storage_log` does not log reads by default because `enable_blob_storage_log_for_read_operations` defaults to false and requires `enable_blob_storage_log`.

topic: On the AWS validation stand, reclaim progressed
canonical_claim: On the AWS validation stand, reclaim progressed from 11 condemned objects in round 24 to graduation in round 26 and deletion of all 11 in round 27; after reclaim fsck reported `dangling=0 unreachable=0 unaccounted=0`.

topic: Phase 4 soak validation compares one CA-local
canonical_claim: Phase 4 soak validation compares one CA-local plus CA-S3 run with retention enabled against one run with `cas_part_folder_cache_bytes = 0`, including anomaly baselines and `CasPartFolderView*` counters.

topic: Freshness-meta validation requires CAS gtests, a deterministic
canonical_claim: Freshness-meta validation requires CAS gtests, a deterministic GC-delete-versus-writer-resurrect race test, ASan, a CA-s3 lane with zero promote aborts and zero fsck dangles, and a soak with meta_without_body equal to zero.

topic: The retired-in-snapshot validation requires the S30 resurrect-churn/recurring-hash
canonical_claim: The retired-in-snapshot validation requires the S30 resurrect-churn/recurring-hash scenario and the S33 concurrent-leader scenario to pass; S33 guards the concurrent-leader reclaim-leak regression and S30 covers the resurrect-supersede path.

topic: The one-hour soak success criteria are two
canonical_claim: The one-hour soak success criteria are two consecutive final `fsck dangling=0 unreachable=0` reads, an empty `ca-gc-dryrun`, no logical-error exceptions, and bounded snapshot/log tails; host logs are archived before teardown.

topic: Round B measures each lever with 10-minute
canonical_claim: Round B measures each lever with 10-minute phase-3 comparative soaks using the same seed and one variable per run, classifying results from per-family `ProfileEvents` deltas summed through `metric_log` because `system.events` resets on chaos restarts.

topic: system.content_addressed_mounts must expose a non-gated lifecycle snapshot
canonical_claim: `system.content_addressed_mounts` must expose a non-gated lifecycle snapshot with `lifecycle`, `lifecycle_reason`, and `lifecycle_since` even when `store()` is refused for a not-live disk.

topic: A future CAS soak intended as a
canonical_claim: A future CAS soak intended as a performance specimen must dump system tables to `utils/ca-soak/logs/` before `compose down`, or persist `/var/lib/clickhouse` on a named volume, because the existing compose setup loses those tables with the container.

topic: A passing dev-scale soak is never treated
canonical_claim: A passing dev-scale soak is never treated as specification-scale validation because each card records its actual scale and verdict.

topic: For CPU, off-CPU, and memory investigations, scenario
canonical_claim: For CPU, off-CPU, and memory investigations, scenario reports must rank `system.trace_log` stacks separately for `CPU`, `Real`, and `Memory` trace types.

topic: The unattended campaign watchdog is intended to
canonical_claim: The unattended campaign watchdog is intended to run every 20 minutes and check fresh progress artifacts, disk usage, CPU starvation, Docker debris, and heavy-build versus soak overlap before intervening.

topic: Phase durations in system.cas_gc_log do not sum
canonical_claim: Phase durations in `system.cas_gc_log` do not sum to `duration_ms`; the `Finish` row's `duration_ms` is authoritative for total round time.

topic: Post-soak validation should mine system.query_log ProfileEvents for
canonical_claim: Post-soak validation should mine system.query_log ProfileEvents for PartsLockWaitMicroseconds, S3 request counters, and Keeper wait events to identify SELECT outliers.

topic: SYSTEM CAS GC RUN returns one result
canonical_claim: `SYSTEM CAS GC RUN` returns one result row per disk with the columns `disk`, `acquired_lease`, `deferred`, `round`, `candidates_marked`, `objects_deleted`, `objects_absent`, `objects_replaced`, `objects_spared`, `manifests_deleted`, `entries_condemned`, `entries_graduated`, `entries_redeleted`, `fence_outs`, and `anomalies`.

topic: A successful SYSTEM CAS GC REBUILD returns
canonical_claim: A successful `SYSTEM CAS GC REBUILD` returns `disk`, `performed`, `round`, `generation`, `namespaces`, `shards`, `committed_refs`, `live_precommits`, `unowned_alive_manifests`, `edges`, and `clamped_shards`.
